correctness.rationale: Let E₀=1, E₁=x, E_(n+2)=xE_(n+1)−aE_n over Z/p^k and C_x=[[x,−a],[1,0]]. The two vectors (x,1) and C_x(x,1) form a basis when a is a unit, so all-index functional periodicity is equivalent to C_x^T=I for every x. Over F_p, eigenvalue orders range over F_p* and the norm-a fiber in F_(p²)*, giving prime-to-p exponent h=p²−1 for nonsquare a and (p²−1)/2 for square a. A repeated-root companion Jordan block adds p in the square field case, and a lifted root at x=2ρ forces exact p^k in every ring. For nonsquare a, no discriminant vanishes and E'_(h−1)(x)=2h/(x²−4a)≠0 mod p; varying a lift x by p ensures some C_x^h differs from I at p², and odd-p binomial lifting gives full p^(k−1) factor. This establishes T=p^(k−1)(p²−1) nonsquare and T=p^k(p²−1)/2 square, for all k≥1. Independent modular matrix arithmetic checked every unit a and all x at p=3,5,7 and k=1,2 and tested the proper prime quotients of the claimed T.
